*   **Team & Partnerships:** The team expanded by adding five new members specializing in cybersecurity and cloud architecture, with an onboarding session on September 10th. Strategic partnerships were established, notably with TechInnovate for AI research. Omar Jensen was mentioned as the lead developer for the development phase.
*   **Budget Updates:** The budget underwent several changes. It started at $500,000 for phase one, was adjusted to $550,000 due to unforeseen expenses, and was later approved at $2 million by the executive board to cover all research, development, and marketing phases.
*   **Meetings & Schedules:** Key meetings were scheduled for June 15th (kick-off), August 5th (initial findings), August 1st (budget allocations), and November 20th (phase two report).
